clusters.name: Meaning in an Indifferent World
clusters.description: Protagonists confront a universe that offers no explanation, drifting through alienation, inexplicable events, and mortality. Each must decide how to act, connect, or endure without any guarantee of purpose.

clusters.name: Tender Misunderstandings
clusters.description: Young adults fumble toward intimacy, in friendships and romances alike, held back by what they can't say aloud. Each book shows how attachment, insecurity, and the distance between private and public selves shape the search for connection.

clusters.name: Tender Misunderstandings
clusters.description: Young adults fumble toward intimacy, in friendships and romances alike, held back by what they can't say aloud. Each book shows how attachment, insecurity, and the distance between private and public selves shape the search for connection.

clusters.name: Absurd Catastrophe, Human Response
clusters.description: Works that confront suffering and a meaningless or indifferent world, questioning comforting beliefs and social systems. They find what dignity there is in solidarity, action, and lucid defiance rather than in faith or optimism.

clusters.name: Strangers Among the Ordinary
clusters.description: Detached protagonists drift at the edges of society, unsure of their place or purpose in a world that expects conformity. Through routine, surrealism, or indifference, each confronts the gap between living a normal life and finding any real meaning in it.
